name: TextFrame2
description: Represents the text frame in a Shape, ShapeRange, or ChartFormat object.
remarks: This object contains the text in the text frame as well as the properties and methods that control the alignment and anchoring of the text frame. Use the TextFrame2 property to return a TextFrame2 object.
example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
With myDocument.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, _
 0, 0, 250, 140).TextFrame2
 .TextRange.Text = "Here is some test text"
 .MarginBottom = 10
 .MarginLeft = 10
 .MarginRight = 10
 .MarginTop = 10
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: MarginBottom
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the bottom of the text frame and the bottom of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write Single.

properties.name: MarginLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the left edge of the text frame and the left edge of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write Single.

properties.name: MarginRight
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the right edge of the text frame and the right edge of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write Single.

properties.name: MarginTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the top of the text frame and the top of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that represents the text frame orientation. Read/write MsoTextOrientation.

properties.name: HorizontalAnchor
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal anchor type for the specified text. Read/write MsoHorizontalAnchor.

properties.name: VerticalAnchor
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical anchor type for the specified text. Read/write MsoVerticalAnchor.

properties.name: PathFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the path type for the specified text frame. Read/write MsoPathFormat.

properties.name: WarpFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the warp type for the specified text frame. Read/write MsoWarpFormat.

properties.name: WordArtformat
properties.description: Returns or sets the Word Art type for the specified text frame. Read/write MsoPresetTextEffect.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: Returns or sets text break lines within or past the boundaries of the shape. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: AutoSize
properties.description: The size of the specified object that changes automatically to fit text within its boundaries. Read/write MsoAutoSize.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns a ThreeDFormat object that contains 3D-effect formatting properties for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: HasText
properties.description: Returns whether the specified text frame has text. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: TextRange
properties.description: Returns the TextRange2 object that represents the text in the object. Read-only.

properties.name: Column
properties.description: Returns the TextColumn2 object that represents the columns within the text frame. Read-only.

properties.name: Ruler
properties.description: Returns a Ruler2 object that represents the ruler for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: NoTextRotation
properties.description: Returns or sets whether text remains flat when the specified object is rotated. Read/write.

methods.name: DeleteText
methods.description: Deletes the text from a text frame and all the associated text properties.
